comment: The languages syl can parse. Each entry names the npm package holding the
grammar source; `npm run grammars:build` compiles it to grammars/<wasm> with
tree-sitter-cli, and that output is committed.
Adding a language means adding an entry here, running the build, and writing
a LanguagePathConfig for it in packages/core/src/tree-sitter/languages/.
Versions are exact on purpose: the wasm in grammars/ is the build product of
this file, and a range would let two checkouts disagree about what that is.
fwcd's grammar, which is the one tree-sitter-wasms shipped and the one
names declarations differently and parses `object X { }` as an ERROR
that swallows the rest of the file, so it is not a drop-in.
